TUR.scope: Turkey 1990: consolidated central government budget (general and annexed budgets) at 2,608.6 TL per US$, plus social security institutions (SSK, Emekli Sandigi, Bag-Kur) estimated. Funds, state enterprises and local governments not covered.

mechs.name: Income tax (wage withholding and declared income)
mechs.note: Income tax, 41% of 1990 tax revenue; 34.4% came from withholding on wages. 1990 scale 25% to 50%, bands approximate.

mechs.name: Corporate tax
mechs.note: Corporate tax at 46% plus fund levies, 10.2% of 1990 tax revenue.

mechs.name: Domestic value-added tax (KDV)
mechs.note: Domestic VAT, 16.9% of 1990 tax revenue; rates 1 to 12%, general rate approximate.

mechs.name: Excise, import VAT, stamp and other goods and services taxes
mechs.note: Fuel and other excises, VAT on imports, stamp, banking and insurance taxes, 13.3% of 1990 tax revenue.

mechs.name: Foreign trade taxes (customs and import levies)
mechs.note: Taxes on foreign trade, 17.7% of 1990 tax revenue.

mechs.name: Other taxes
mechs.note: Other indirect taxes, 0.1% of 1990 tax revenue.

mechs.name: Non-tax revenue
mechs.note: Property income, state monopolies, fees, fines and other non-tax receipts, 1990 consolidated budget (17.1% of revenue).

mechs.name: Annexed budget revenue
mechs.note: Revenue of annexed-budget bodies such as universities and the highway department (2.7% of revenue).

mechs.name: Social security contributions (estimated)
mechs.note: SSK, Emekli Sandigi and Bag-Kur own income, estimated midway between 1989 (8.1 trn TL) and 1991 (29.3 trn TL) totals, less budget transfers.
